breathCueTheme.title: Мягкое дыхательное движение
breathCueTheme.behavior: Inhale and exhale are separate phase waves: each starts with a fast click-safe onset, then smoothly decays to silence by the phase end. Inhale is brighter; exhale is warmer and darker. Hold cues are quieter air textures stretched across the full hold and faded to silence before the next phase. Breathing masters loop at natural speed when needed; transition cues remain short one-shots.
